descriptions.d19d_clamp_root_interval_80197128: While x = *first + epsilon < 4/3, clamp *second (with margin epsilon) between the real roots of t^2 + (x - 2) t + (x - 1)^2 computed with sqrt 0x802e82c0; otherwise set the pair to (4/3, 1/3) minus epsilon. Owns its float literal pool (4/3, 2, 1, 4, 0.5, 1/3).
